about_the_game:
What's this demo

This is an early demo of UnLoop – a retro-futuristic VR puzzle game built around self-cooperative time loop mechanics.

How long is it

The demo features 8 initial levels, giving you the chance to test your abilities, learn the main gameplay loop, and interact with the first two puzzle mechanics: cards and batteries!

Currently supported headsets and controllers

  • Meta Quest 2/3/3S/Pro

  • Pico 3/4/Neo

Visuals in the demo are identical to those on the Meta Quest 3/3S because this demo is a port of the standalone version of the game.

For the full release, we plan to improve the visuals and add support for more headsets and controllers.

Sitting mode

The game is designed to be played while standing, but there is an accessibility setting that allows you to switch between sitting and standing manually via a button.

Leaderboards

Not live yet, placeholders are in place instead.

content_descriptors.notes: The gameplay involves solving puzzles, with each loop showing you (= your copies) repeating past actions. Sometimes, you can end your run early by killing yourself (or your copies from previous loops).

short_description: UnLoop is a retro-futuristic VR puzzle game built around self-cooperative time loop mechanics. As a spy infiltrating a remote space station, you encounter a temporal phenomenon that creates copies of yourself each loop. Learning to work with your past selves becomes the only way forward.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Simplified Chinese
